assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D action RPG modular PLAYER BODY animation sheet. The supplied image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, not a layout to copy. Create a BRAND NEW sheet with exactly16 isolated full cat-body sprites in a precise4-column by4-row square grid. Match the cute round-faced heroic orange/white cats, large expressive eyes, painted storybook game rendering and three-quarter side view facing RIGHT in the reference. The front arms and weapons are animated separately by the game: draw the HEAD, TORSO, LEGS, FEET, TAIL, shoulder caps and armor only, with NO ARMS, NO HANDS, NO GUNS, NO STAFF. Leave the front shoulder area clean to attach an arm layer. Keep both ears and face visible. 2048x2048 if possible. Each complete sprite fits inside central70% of its own square cell, generous transparent gutters on every side at least35px; all tails, fabric and ears fully inside cell, nothing overlaps. Same cat proportions and body size, feet baseline at85% of cell except prone pose. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no ground shadows or scene. No captions, text, numbers, borders, grids, or extra items. Exact ordering: row1 ORANGE CAT with green eyes: idle standing; running strideA; running strideB; running strideC. Row2 same orange cat: running strideD; low forward evasive crouch; recoiling hurt standing eyes squeezed; downed curled body lying horizontally on side. Row3 WHITE CAT with blue eyes: idle;runningA;runningB;runningC. Row4 same white cat: runningD;low evasive crouch;hurt recoil;downed lying sideways. These are independent cutout sprites, actual different motion poses. New armor design: STORMRUNNER: sleek teal and dark navy scout coat, short turquoise scarf streaming gently behind neck, pale silver lightweight shoulder caps, leather ammunition belt, fitted dark trousers and soft boots, small cyan lightning-shaped stitched accent. Athletic skirmisher silhouette, stylish asymmetrical short capelet. Orange cat keeps warm orange fur/green eyes; white cat keeps white fur/blue eyes. Same armor for both.
